title: Paul McCartney live: Palace Square, St Petersburg | 2004
content:
Paul McCartney performed at Palace Square in St Petersburg, Russia, on 20 June 2004.

It was the 12th show of the 04 Summer Tour, which lasted for 14 dates in May and June 2004. This was said to be McCartney’s 3,000th concert.

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), and Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums).
